title: Real Programmers Don’t Use Pascal
summary: Summary withheld: an Opus review found that the machine-written summary did not match the post. Read the original post.

quotes.text: For the first time, the translator participates in figuring out what you meant. It fills gaps, it proposes, it asks back, it iterates.
quotes.why_it_matters: This explains the fundamental shift from AI-assisted coding: machines no longer just execute explicit specifications but actively collaborate in clarifying intent.

quotes.text: That skill survived the plugboards, survived assembly, survived every language crusade, and it will survive the agents too, because it is not a layer.
quotes.why_it_matters: This emphasizes that verification and intent-checking is a meta-skill independent of any specific technology layer, explaining why it persists across all transitions.
